create_competition_info: create a CompetitionInfo dataclass that downloads and parses competition config and markdown files from Hugging Face Hub
build_competition_properties: build a CompetitionInfo instance to access properties like submission_limit, end_date, competition_type, and scoring_metric
update_competition_info: update competition config and markdown files on Hugging Face Hub by calling update_competition_info with new config and markdowns
review_competition_properties: review the CompetitionInfo class properties to inspect submission_columns, dataset_description, rules, and hardware configuration
test_competition_info_init: test the CompetitionInfo initialization by passing a competition_id and autotrain_token to download competition files
